members.doc: Returns the bidirectional class assigned to the character chr as string. If no such value is defined, an empty string is returned.

members.name: category
members.doc: Returns the general category assigned to the character chr as string.

members.name: combining
members.doc: Returns the canonical combining class assigned to the character chr as integer. Returns 0 if no combining class is defined.

members.name: decomposition
members.doc: Returns the character decomposition mapping assigned to the character chr as string. An empty string is returned in case no such mapping is defined.

members.name: east_asian_width
members.doc: Returns the east asian width assigned to the character chr as string.

members.name: is_normalized
members.doc: Return whether the Unicode string unistr is in the normal form 'form'. Valid values for form are 'NFC', 'NFKC', 'NFD', and 'NFKD'.

members.name: lookup
members.doc: Look up character by name. If a character with the given name is found, return the corresponding character. If not found, KeyError is raised.

members.name: mirrored
members.doc: Returns the mirrored property assigned to the character chr as integer. Returns 1 if the character has been identified as a "mirrored" character in bidirectiona

members.name: name
members.doc: Returns the name assigned to the character chr as a string. If no name is defined, default is returned, or, if not given, ValueError is raised.

members.name: normalize
members.doc: Return the normal form 'form' for the Unicode string unistr. Valid values for form are 'NFC', 'NFKC', 'NFD', and 'NFKD'.
